vars.ansible_become_password: {{ (s.become_1 | b64decode) if s.become_1 is defined else omit }}

ansible.builtin.shell.cmd:
me=$(ps -o pgid= -p $$ 2>/dev/null | tr -d ' ')
left() { ps -eo pgid=,stat= 2>/dev/null | awk -v g="$g" '$1 == g && $2 !~ /^Z/' | grep -q .; }
for p in "$HOME/.opsdeck/runs/{{ od.rel }}"/od-*.pgid; do
  [ -f "$p" ] || continue
  m="${p##*/}"
  g=$(cat "$p" 2>/dev/null)
  ours=
  case "$g" in ''|*[!0-9]*) ;; *) if [ "$g" -gt 1 ] && [ "$g" != "$me" ] && ps -eo pgid=,args= 2>/dev/null | awk -v g="$g" '$1 == g' | grep -qF -- "$m"; then ours=1; fi;; esac
  if [ -n "$ours" ]; then
    kill -TERM -- "-$g" 2>/dev/null
    n=0; while [ "$n" -lt 5 ] && left; do sleep 1; n=$((n+1)); done
    if left; then sudo -n kill -TERM -- "-$g" 2>/dev/null; sleep 2; fi
    if left; then echo "CredOps warning: could not stop step process group $g ($m)"; else echo "stopped step process group $g"; fi
  fi
  rm -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || sudo -n rm -f "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
done
rc=0
seen=" "
for r in {{ od.lock_repos | map('quote') | join(' ') }}; do
  G="$r"; while [ ! -e "$G/.git" ] && [ "$G" != / ] && [ -n "$G" ]; do G=$(dirname "$G"); done
  [ -e "$G/.git" ] || G="$r"
  case "$seen" in *" $G "*) continue;; esac
  seen="$seen$G "
  f="$G/.opsdeck-deploy.lock"
  cur=$(cat "$f" 2>/dev/null)
  [ -n "$cur" ] || continue
  echo "OD-LOCK $cur"
  if case "$cur" in *'"releaseId":"{{ od.rel }}"'*) true;; *) false;; esac; then rm -f "$f"; echo "OD-UNLOCK released $G"; else echo "OD-UNLOCK kept $G"; :; fi
done
rm -rf "$HOME/.opsdeck/runs/{{ od.rel }}"
exit "$rc"
